EP02:E66 93200-96800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.
EP02:E67 93400-96600 LADY JULIANA [Decisive, Scathing]: "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
EP02:E68 96800-98200 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
EP02:E69 98200-102800 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
EP02:E70 98200-102800 ACTION: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
EP02:E71 98500-102400 LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Proud]: "I may leave this chapel without a husband..."
EP02:E72 102800-110000 CAMERA: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.
EP02:E73 103000-107400 LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit]: "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed."
